text:
maya: Hey folks — opened a docs PR for the SDK snippet migration and a small migration guide tweak. Need a quick review & to confirm auto-merge rules. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345

Tom: On it. Is this primarily code examples (py/js) + one link fix?

maya: Yep. Python + JS snippets updated to the new client patterns, and replaced an old internal link in /guides/deployments. Also added a short changelog line.

docs-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-2345--docs.redwood.com — checks: docs-preview (failed), link-checker (passed)

jen: CI shows docs-preview failed due to a fenced code block indentation in the Python snippet. I pushed a tiny formatting commit (will reference in PR).

sam: FYI per CODEOWNERS we need 2 reviewers from @docs and one from @platform for changes under /docs/sdk. Are the CODEOWNERS entries up to date?

maya: Good point. I used the existing CODEOWNERS, but I wanted to confirm the auto-merge config. Currently the repo auto-merge rule requires: passing CI, 2 approvals, no requested changes.

Tom: That's what our branch protection says. We can't auto-merge until the `docs-preview` check is green. Can we make docs-preview less flaky?

jen: We should, but short term we can allow the preview to be red if link-checker + lint pass? That requires changing the required checks list in branch protection. Not ideal for security/observability.

li: I can review the content now. @maya — any functional changes in code examples or just API/usage surface updates?

maya: Mostly API surface changes: `Client.create()` -> `new Client()` and `client.generate()` -> `client.text.generate()`. No behavioral changes.

li: Got it. I'll do a pass for accuracy.

sam: Another option: add a small required GitHub Check that signals docs-stable (a lightweight lint) and make it required instead of the heavier full preview for auto-merge. Then maintainers can still view the preview link manually.

maya: Is adding a new check heavy? Who owns GH Actions for docs?

jen: @sam and I can add a small action that runs the snippet linter + link checks and posts `docs-stable` status. It's quick to implement. But we'll need to update branch protection to include that check.

Tom: Also consider CODEOWNERS gaps. Current file snippet:
```
# CODEOWNERS
/docs/sdk/* @docs @platform
/guides/* @docs
/examples/* @platform
```
If new files are created under /examples, they sometimes miss platform review. We should match patterns to real dirs.

maya: I didn't add new files, just edited existing ones.

docs-bot: GitHub Checks: docs-preview (failed), docs-lint (passed), link-checker (passed), codeowners-check (passed)

li: Reviewing PR now — small nit: the JS snippet still has `client.run()` in one spot. I left an inline comment.

maya: Thanks — fixed and pushed.

jen: After jen's formatting commit and maya's fix, I re-ran CI. docs-preview is still timing out occasionally (intermittent). Could we increase the timeout or cache the built preview to avoid flakiness?

sam: Caching helps. There's a known issue where the preview build pulls large model sample assets. We could mock those in CI. I'll open a follow-up issue to reduce preview runtime.

Tom: For this PR specifically, do we have enough reviewers to approve now? li + tom + jen? That would be 3. Branch protection requires 2, so we're fine once li approves.

li: Approved. 

maya: Thanks! Once the preview goes green I'll try to enable auto-merge. Do we need admin approval to flip the required checks to include `docs-stable` instead of `docs-preview`?

sam: Yes, branch protection changes require repo admin. I can coordinate with ops to schedule a quick change. We should document the new check name and rationale in the repo README.

maya: Sounds good. If ops can flip to `docs-stable` and keep `link-checker` required, we can enable auto-merge on this PR once 2 approvals + passing checks.

docs-bot: PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — status: approvals=2, checks=docs-lint: ✅, link-checker: ✅, docs-preview: ⏳

jen: Minor note — if we automate approvals for certain bot accounts we should avoid bypassing CODEOWNERS. Don't want platform-only changes auto-approved by docs bots.

sam: Agreed. Bot approvals should not count toward CODEOWNERS-required reviewers. We can configure the action to request specific team approvals.

maya: OK — plan: 1) li approves (done), 2) wait for docs-preview or switch to docs-stable once ops flips branch protection, 3) enable auto-merge for the PR. I'll file a short runbook for the branch-protection switch after this thread.

Tom: Sounds good. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

li: glad we got it sorted.

maya: I'll merge once the checks are green or ops flips the check to docs-stable. Thanks all!
